subject: Renewal + expansion: Private/VPC — new environment and additional clusters
messages:
From: Ava Liao <ava.liao@cloudworks.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: Derek Cho <derek.cho@cloudworks.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal + expansion: Private VPC — new environment and additional clusters

Hi Jonas,

We’re coming up on our Redwood renewal (contract expires 2027-03-31) and want to confirm a few items before procurement issues a new PO. We are planning to add a separate VPC environment for our EU customer-facing workloads and provision two extra inference clusters (N2 equivalent, ~8 gpus each) for peak capacity. New requirements:

- Strict network isolation between production and EU environment (VPC peering not allowed; needs standalone VPC).
- Separate logging/audit sink that CloudWorks controls (S3 endpoint + KMS key).
- SOC 2 evidence and updated data retention terms (90 days by default, must support 30-day hot cache).
- Proposed go-live for the new environment: 2027-05-10 to coincide with a product launch.

Can you send updated pricing, any term changes for adding on-prem/private clusters, and the order form we should send to procurement? Also attach any docs you need us to sign (SOW/order form/updated T&Cs). I’ve attached our internal network requirements for reference.

Thanks — we want to lock this before our finance close next week.

— Ava
Ava Liao
Senior Procurement Manager
CloudWorks

Hi Ava — thanks for the clear summary and the network brief. We can definitely support a separate VPC environment and the two additional clusters you described. High-level next steps from our side:

1) I’ll share an updated SOW and order form (attaching draft SOW and order workbook).
2) Our infra team will review your network PDF and confirm any firewall/peering requirements (cc’ing Rishi).
3) We’ll include an itemized fee for the stand-alone VPC+isolation and the additional cluster capacity; I’ll put the initial estimate below.

Estimate (ballpark, subject to final sizing):
- Two additional N2-equivalent clusters (8x GPUs each): $38,000/mo (committed)
- Standalone VPC environment / isolation premium: one-time setup $18,000 + $3,500/mo
- SCA / SOC2 evidence exchange: included for enterprise customers; any extra compliance work billed T&M

I’ve attached: redwood-sow-v2.pdf and redwood-order-form-CloudWorks.xlsx for procurement. If those look good I can turn them into a DocuSign envelope and we’ll draft a rollout calendar. Would you be available for a 30-min call tomorrow to align on timeline?

Best,

Team — forwarding Ava’s note. CloudWorks wants a separate VPC environment (no peering) and two additional clusters (N2 equiv, ~8 GPUs each) with a target go-live 2027-05-10. Key asks: isolated logging sink, KMS for their S3, and SOC2 packaging.

Questions:
- Rishi: can we support fully isolated VPCs (standalone control plane) in their requested region with current templates? Any infra lead time or infra fee we should surface?
- Evelyn: will CS/Onboarding be able to run the rollout in a 6-week window if infra is ready by 03/15?

— Jonas
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: Ava Liao <ava.liao@cloudworks.com>, Derek Cho <derek.cho@cloudworks.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal + expansion: CloudWorks — need sizing + isolation guidance

Jonas & team — reviewed the network PDF and the requested footprint. Quick notes from infra:

- Isolation: We can provision a standalone VPC with a customer-dedicated control plane (no peering). This requires a one-time infra setup and a small control-plane license addendum. Lead time: ~4 weeks from SOW signature for env provisioning (depending on region capacity).
- Cluster sizing: Two N2-eq clusters (8 GPUs each) is reasonable. We recommend adding a 10% buffer for KV-cache pressure during peak launches. If CloudWorks expects >2x peak traffic within 30 days of launch, consider an additional hot cluster as a buffer.
- Costs: the one-time setup aligns with the $18k number Jonas listed; operational delta is ~$3.5k/mo for the isolated control plane. Any on-prem or air-gapped variant would increase setup and quarterly support fees.
- Data retention: we can provide 90/30 retention buckets; 30-day hot cache will require increased disk IO provisioning (adds modest monthly cost).

Risks / actions:
- Need signed SOW to commit capacity.
- We should confirm network egress/cert boundaries with their security team (Derek).

Proposed rollout timeline (best effort):
- 2027-03-15: SOW signed / PO cleared
- 2027-03-22 to 2027-04-18: infra provisioning and validation
- 2027-04-19 to 2027-05-03: staging validation and smoke tests
- 2027-05-10: target production cutover

I’ll pull a short statement of work update with the timing called out.

— Rishi
Senior Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference
